data.one_liner: Lightweight bindings for browser APIs via JS interop
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart wrappers around standard web APIs such as document, XMLHttpRequest, WebAssembly, and more. It replaces dart:html for Dart compiled to JS or WASM.
use_when: Migrating a Dart web app from dart:html to a more modern API
Need direct access to browser APIs in a Dart-only codebase
Want zero‑overhead bindings for web features
avoid_when: You only need a subset of APIs and prefer a smaller dependency
strengths: Supports both JS and WASM targets
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: No support for native mobile or desktop APIs
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import 'package:web/web.dart';
